record.question: Network Interface Card (NIC) is
options: A peripheral device used to point to items on monitor
A device used to connect one computer to another over a phone line
A board inserted in a computer that provides a physical connection to a network
A device that reads and or writes information on a disk
record.explanation: A NIC provides a computer with a physical network connection; it can be an add-in board or an integrated component, so the option is simplified. Evidence: https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/solutions/enterprise-networks/what-is-a-network-interface-card.html Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
